general.summary: Bruce Richards, managing partner and head of CVC Marathon, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on “Bloomberg Money.” They discuss Richards’ favorite investing advice he has received throughout his career. Richards warns about irrational markets and also says he’s not a fan of leveraged ETF structures. (Source: Bloomberg)

Adjusting for Credit Risk: Masters In Business with David Eichhorn
general.summary: Barry speaks with David Eichhorn, CEO and Head of Investment Strategies at NISA Investment Advisors. They discuss his early days as a quant at JPMorgan before returning home to St. Louis to work at NISA. They also discuss the risks and benefits of the private credit market, along with the dangers of private credit going into pension funds and 401Ks. They also discuss liability investment strategies for managing over $483 billion in client assets. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fear and ‘Hot Sauce’: Young Investors Want To Catch Up
general.summary: Buzzy stocks, leveraged ETFs, and a generation feeling left behind. BlackRock’s Gargi Chaudhuri discusses ways investors can dabble in risky products while also leaning into time-proven strategies. On this week’s “Bloomberg Money”, she joins Tom Keene and Scarlet Fu, who gives a shoutout to @Eric Balchunas and his coverage of ‘hot sauce’ investment products. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fiber Network Operator Zayo Delays Public ABS Sale Until 2027
general.summary: Fiber-optic network operator Zayo Group Holdings Inc. is delaying the public-market leg of a planned asset-backed securities offering, while moving ahead with the privately placed portion, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
